L.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; standing in an arriving crowd outside a stadium, speaking up a little into her phone; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.

T.audio_profile: A tall, calm man of 30 with a low, dry, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; he speaks from close behind her shoulder and never raises his voice.

dialogue_turns.text: [bright, excited, to the camera, over the crowd] Ten minutes to kick-off!
[low, suspicious, close behind her] What's your battery?
[small and quiet, reading it off her screen; then light and innocent] Four. Why?
[slow, patient, flat, going straight on without a stop] Because the tickets are on that phone, and that phone is about to die.

payload.scene: A phone vlog in the crowd outside the turnstile gate of a football stadium at dusk, ten minutes before kick-off; the floodlights are on and people are arriving all around. Luna holds the phone at arm's length and talks to it; Timo stands just behind her and leans in over her shoulder.
payload.sample_context: An eight-second comedy sketch played by two close friends who bicker. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful and quick; she is thrilled to be at the gate; asked about her battery she goes small for one word and is innocent again at once, never sarcastic. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice; he has spotted a problem before she has, and he explains it slowly and patiently, in one unhurried breath. They answer each other fast, with no gaps between the lines.

text: Ten minutes to kick off. What's your battery? Four. Why? Because the tickets are on that phone and that phone is about to die.
